handgun_purchase: Handgun sales to most civilians should be banned.
Buying a handgun should require a license with safety training, plus a background check for every sale.
Every handgun sale, including private sales, should require a background check, but no license.
Keep current federal law: checks at licensed dealers, but not for most private sales.
There should be fewer federal rules on buying handguns, such as no required background checks.
private_sale_checks: Every gun sale or transfer between private people should require a background check, even between family members.
Every private gun sale should require a check, but not gifts or loans between family and close friends.
Private gun sales should require a check only at gun shows and online.
Private gun sales shouldn't require a background check.
semi_auto_rifles: New sales of semi-automatic rifles like the AR-15 should be banned, and the government should buy back the ones people own.
New sales should be banned, but people can keep the ones they have.
Semi-automatic rifles should be sold only to people 21 and older with a license and training.
Semi-automatic rifles should be sold with a background check, as most states do now.
Semi-automatic rifles should be sold with no federal background check.
magazine_limit: Gun magazines should be limited to 10 rounds or fewer.
Gun magazines should be limited to about 15 to 20 rounds.
There shouldn't be a limit on magazine size.
concealed_carry: Carrying a concealed handgun in public should generally not be allowed, except for police and security guards.
Carrying a concealed handgun should require a permit with training and a background check.
Carrying a concealed handgun should require a permit with a background check, but no training.
Adults who can legally own a gun should be able to carry it concealed with no permit.
carry_locations: People with a carry permit shouldn't be allowed to carry here: {case}.
People with a carry permit should be allowed to carry here: {case}.
red_flag: Courts should be able to temporarily take guns from someone found dangerous, when police or family members ask.
Courts can temporarily take guns only when police ask, after a quick hearing where the person can respond.
Guns should be taken only after a criminal conviction or a formal mental health commitment.
red_flag_cases: A court should be able to temporarily take guns from this person: {case}.
A court shouldn't be able to take guns from this person: {case}.
gun_purchase_age: No one under 21 should be able to buy any gun.
People should be 21 to buy handguns and semi-automatic rifles, and 18 for hunting rifles and shotguns.
People should be 21 to buy handguns and 18 for rifles and shotguns, from any seller.
Anyone 18 or older should be able to buy any gun.
second_amendment_meaning: The Second Amendment protects only the right of states to keep militias, not an individual right to own guns.
The Second Amendment protects an individual right to own guns, but government can regulate it broadly.
The Second Amendment protects an individual right to own guns, with only narrow limits.
The Second Amendment protects an individual right to own guns, with almost no limits.
self_defense_law: When attacked in public, a person should have to retreat first if it can be done safely, before using deadly force.
A person should have to retreat first only if they started the conflict.
A person can stand their ground and use deadly force anywhere they have a right to be, without retreating.
gun_maker_liability: Gun makers and sellers should be open to lawsuits when their guns are used in crimes, like makers of other dangerous products.
Gun makers and sellers should be sued only if they broke the law or marketed irresponsibly.
Gun makers and sellers should keep today's protection from these lawsuits.
gun_registry: There should be a national registry of who owns every gun.
There should be a national registry only for handguns and semi-automatic rifles.
There shouldn't be a national gun registry.
suppressors: Civilians shouldn't be able to buy gun suppressors.
Buying a suppressor should keep requiring federal registration and approval, as now.
Suppressors should be sold like ordinary gun parts, with no special registration.
